verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no AI assistant built into Gusto itself. What it documents is external AI tooling: an official MCP server that lets third-party LLMs such as Claude or ChatGPT query Gusto data, a Dev Assistant MCP for code editors, and an agent-friendly CLI with skills that install into external agent tools. These are adjacent integrations for outside agents, not a native assistant users can delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
